e:12px}
.create-option small{font-size:9px;line-height:1.45;color:#8799a8}
.create-icon{font-size:24px;font-weight:950;color:#70d2ff}
.create-foot{margin-top:13px;text-align:center}
.import-preview{max-height:330px;overflow:auto;margin-top:14px;border:1px solid #2d3e4d;border-radius:12px;background:#0e151c}
.import-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px minmax(220px,1fr) 70px 70px;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:8px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #1f2d38;font-size:10px}
.import-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.import-row.head{position:sticky;top:0;background:#151f28;color:#728493;font-size:8px;font-weight:950;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}
.player-picker{max-height:430px;overflow:auto;margin-top:12px}
.pick-player{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:8px 9px;border-bottom:1px solid #263643}
.pick-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.pick-player .avatar{width:34px;height:34px}
.untiered-sep{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:18px 0 8px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:10px;background:#111922;border:1px solid #293846;color:#94a5b4}
.untiered-sep b{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
.empty-list{padding:44px 20px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed #304352;border-radius:14px;background:#10171e}
.empty-list h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:15px}
.empty-list p{margin:0 auto 14px;max-width:520px;color:#8394a3;font-size:10px;line-height:1.55}
.market-add{margin-left:3px;border:0;background:#22303b;color:#9edcff;border-radius:7px;padding:3px 7px;font-size:8px;font-weight:950;transition:.12s ease}
.market-add:hover{background:#2a3c4b;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.auth-gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:radial-gradient(750px 430px at 50% 10%,#1a3347,#080d12 64%);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:30px}
.auth-gate.open{display:flex}
.auth-card{width:min(410px,94vw);max-height:calc(100vh - 48px);overflow:auto;background:#111922;border:1px solid #334655;border-radius:20px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 30px 80px #000a}
.auth-brand{font-size:31px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.045em;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fff,#dce7ef 52%,#55afff);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
.auth-kicker{text-align:center;color:#75889a;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.32em;margin:7px 0 28px}
.auth-card h2{font-size:18px;margin:0 0 5px}
.auth-card input{width:100%;background:#0c131a;border:1px solid #344656;color:#eef3f7;border-radius:11px;padding:11px 12px;margin-top:9px;outline:none}
.auth-main{width:100%;margin-top:12px}
.auth-links{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:12px}
.auth-links button,.local-preview-link{border:0;background:transparent;color:#8296a8;font-size:10px}
.auth-links button:hover,.local-preview-link:hover{color:#d8e4ec}
.local-preview-link{display:block;margin:18px auto 0}
@media(max-width:1280px){.create-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}.list-switcher{min-width:270px}.list-switcher select{min-width:180px}}


@media(max-height:760px){
  .modal{padding:12px}
  .modalbox{max-height:calc(100vh - 24px);width:min(820px,calc(100vw - 24px));margin:auto}
  .create-option{min-height:118px}
  .create-options{gap:8px}
  .section{margin-top:14px}
}

</style>
</head>

      <button class="mini-plus" id="newListTop" title="New ranking list">＋</button>

      <button class="btn primary" id="topUpdate">↻ Update Current ADP</button>
      <button class="btn account-btn" id="accountBtn">Sign In</button>
      <button class="btn" id="settingsBtn">Settings</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="brand-lockup">
    <div class="brand-lockup-inner">
      <div class="brand-mark"><img src="data:image/webp;base64,
